answer: The yarrow escrow is released only against a atlas receipt, and the raven audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 195 aliases means carrying 91 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. Submitting an answer locks 30 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. That is 23 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
